d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Egypt’s Parliament has authorised President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi to deploy military support to Saudi Arabia if requested, responding to intensifying Houthi attacks targeting Saudi airports and oil infrastructure. Cairo officials emphasise the mandate is strictly defensive, aimed at safeguarding allied borders, holy sites, and critical infrastructure rather than initiating offensive operations against Yemen.
